video.agency.evidence: [影魔·codex] 图1第3行第1–8格（4.000–5.750秒），我被围住后，头肩位置与收身姿态近乎不变，看不清持续收臂、下沉或受击震动，无法确认我一直在主动蓄力并回应攻击，有原地停等感。规格要求5.3–6秒猛然展臂释放，但第4行第1格（6.000秒）仍未见明确展开，到第2格（6.250秒）才出现明显展臂与魂柱。持续蓄力及按拍反击的行为链无法确认，按要求判fail。；[树人·claude] Judged as the treant. 0–1.75 s (row 1): the treants charge toward him from all sides, which is correct. 2.0–3.75 s (row 2): they surround him, and sparks appear on his shoulder armor at 2.25 s and 3.25 s, so they are probably striking him. From 4.0 s to 5.75 s (row 3), the ring of treants is a dark, almost motionless mass with no sparks. I can't tell whether they are still striking every 0.7 s, so they may have stopped attacking ('treants stop striking'). The bigger problem is at 6.25–6.75 s (row 4, cells 2–4): the black pillars have already burst out and are passing through the treants, but several treants are still standing or moving among the pillars. They do not fall the instant the ring hits them. Only in the 7.0–7.5 s cells are they blurred into flying dust and debris, and the grey-white corpses first show clearly at about 8.5 s. That breaks the spec's '5.3–6 s: a treant dies and falls flat on its back the moment the ring passes it' and hits the negatives 'treants keep walking between the pillars / treants fall only after a delay'. No cell shows a clear backward fall either; the treants are standing, then they are corpses. The cause and the treants' reaction do not line up cleanly.

video.gaze.evidence: [影魔·codex] 图1第1行至第2行（0–3.750秒），我的脸大体朝画面前方，无法辨认先扫视四周、再锁定攻击最凶者的视线变化；第3行（4.000–5.750秒）头部细节被遮挡，无法确认低吼前后盯住正前方树人。第5行（8.000–9.750秒）也未清楚呈现低头扫视尸圈。拼图中眼部过小，不能确认是否看镜头，也不能确认各拍视线对象，按要求判fail。；[树人·claude] In the 0–1.75 s cells (row 1), the treants are running in toward him and their bodies face him, which is roughly correct. In the 2.0–5.75 s cells (rows 2–3), the treants are tiny and packed into one dark mass. I can't see whether their crowns are tilted up toward him as the 1.5–5 s spec requires ('the treants surrounding him all look up at him while striking hard'), and in the 4.0–5.75 s cells most of them are just dark silhouettes with no readable head direction. In the 6.25–6.75 s cells, the treants still standing among the pillars have no visible facing either, which I can't determine. Where the gaze can't be verified, I judge fail. No cell shows a treant looking at the camera.

video.readability.evidence: [audience·claude] Watching the contact sheet cold, the story comes through clearly. 0–1.75s (row 1): a fire-and-lava demon stands at the centre while many dark, ghoul-like creatures charge at it. 2–3.75s (row 2): the creatures swarm around the demon and pile on. Some ember light still shows on its body, so it is not fully buried yet. 4–5.75s (row 3): the demon is almost completely covered, and a dark shockwave ring spreads on the ground around it, which reads as a skill charging up. At 6.0s the demon's head glows red. 6.25–8.0s (row 4 to the start of row 5): many huge dark-grey spikes or shockwave columns burst out from the demon's position, and the surrounding creatures are blown away in dust. 8.5–8.75s: the smoke clears and the demon stands alone with its arms spread. 9.0–11.75s (rows 5–6): the creatures lie on the ground as pale-grey corpses all around, and the demon's body flares back up with fire. A viewer can say: the demon was surrounded, used a burst skill, and wiped out the whole swarm, which is a visible result. Weak points that do not change the verdict: the demon is almost invisible for about 2s (4–6s, row 3); the spikes are dark grey on a grey-brown background, so contrast is low and they are not very flashy; and the creatures are dark brown on dark ground, so they are hard to tell apart at thumbnail size.
